name: Zhejiang Cayi Vacuum Container Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Cayi Vacuum Container Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, design, production, and sale of beverage and food containers of various materials in China and internationally. The company offers stainless steel water bottle, tumbler and mug, wine cup, vacuum flask, and kids bottle; travel mug and bottle, straw tumbler, and stainless steel jug; and stainless steel vacuum insulated containers, such as insulated cups, flasks, food jars, thermos pots, and smart cups; stainless steel containers; plastic containers; glass containers, and other new materials for daily beverages and food containers.
